title: The Art of Continuous Learning in Tech
excerpt: How to stay relevant and curious in an industry that never stops moving.

content.text: In the world of technology, the only constant is change. What was cutting-edge last year might be legacy today. This rapid evolution can be overwhelming, but it's also what makes our field so exciting.

Continuous learning isn't just about picking up the latest framework; it's about developing a mindset that welcomes new challenges. It's about being comfortable with not knowing everything and having the confidence to figure it out.
I've found that the best way to keep up is to focus on fundamentals. While tools change, the core principles of software engineering, design, and problem-solving remain remarkably stable.
Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
content.author: Mahatma Gandhi

content.text: Whether it's reading a technical book, contributing to open source, or building a small side project, every bit of learning compounds over time. The goal isn't to be an expert in everything, but to be a lifelong student of the craft.
